text_en: Thus says the Lord : I am going to stir up a destructive wind against Babylon and against the inhabitants of Leb-qamai;
text_cn: 上主这样说：“看，我必要兴起毁灭的飓风，袭击巴比伦和加色丁的居民，

text_en: and I will send winnowers to Babylon, and they shall winnow her. They shall empty her land when they come against her from every side on the day of trouble.
text_cn: 给巴比伦派簸手来簸扬她，扫空她的国土，因为在祸患之日，人必四面向她进攻。”

text_en: Let not the archer bend his bow, and let him not array himself in his coat of mail. Do not spare her young men; utterly destroy her entire army.
text_cn: 弓手不要放下自己的弓箭，战士不要卸下自己的铠甲，不要怜恤她的青年，却要歼灭她所有的部队，

text_en: They shall fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and wounded in her streets.
text_cn: 使他们倒毙在加色丁境内，沿途被人刺杀，

text_en: Israel and Judah have not been forsaken by their God, the Lord of hosts, though their land is full of guilt before the Holy One of Israel.
text_cn: 因为他们的国土，充满了反抗以色列圣者的罪恶；可是以色列和犹大并未成为寡妇，也未丧失自己的天主，万军的上主。

text_en: Flee from the midst of Babylon, save your lives, each of you! Do not perish because of her guilt, for this is the time of the Lord ’s vengeance; he is repaying her what is due.
text_cn: 你们逃离巴比伦，各救自己的性命，不要因了她的罪过而自遭丧亡，因为现在是上主复仇的时候，上主要对她报复。

text_en: Babylon was a golden cup in the Lord ’s hand, making all the earth drunken; the nations drank of her wine, and so the nations went mad.
text_cn: 巴比伦在上主手中，曾是个灌醉大地的金爵，万民饮了她的酒，万民才如此狂乱。

text_en: Suddenly Babylon has fallen and is shattered; wail for her! Bring balm for her wound; perhaps she may be healed.
text_cn: 霎（shà）时间，巴比伦倾覆瓦解，你们为她举哀，拿香料来医治她的创伤，也许她会痊愈。

text_en: We tried to heal Babylon, but she could not be healed. Forsake her, and let each of us go to our own country; for her judgment has reached up to heaven and has been lifted up even to the skies.
text_cn: 我们本愿治愈巴比伦，但是她却不痊愈；我们放下她，各自回归故乡，因为她罪恶滔天，直达云霄。

text_en: The Lord has brought forth our vindication; come, let us declare in Zion the work of the Lord our God.
text_cn: 上主表彰了我们的正义，来，我们在熙雍称扬上主我们的天主的伟业。

text_en: Sharpen the arrows! Fill the quivers! The Lord has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes, because his purpose concerning Babylon is to destroy it, for that is the vengeance of the Lord , vengeance for his temple.
text_cn: 磨尖箭矢，装满箭囊！上主已激起玛待王的锐气，因为他对巴比伦的计划，是要将她消灭；是上主报复，为自己的殿宇复仇。

text_en: Raise a standard against the walls of Babylon; make the watch strong; post sentinels; prepare the ambushes; for the Lord has both planned and done what he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.
text_cn: 你们向巴比伦城墙树立旗帜，加紧防卫，派驻防哨，预设埋伏，因为上主怎样计划了，就怎样实践他对巴比伦居民所下的断语。

text_en: You who live by mighty waters, rich in treasures, your end has come, the thread of your life is cut.
text_cn: 啊，你住在多水之旁，富有宝藏；现在到了你的结局，到了切断你尺度的时刻。

text_en: The Lord of hosts has sworn by himself: Surely I will fill you with troops like a swarm of locusts, and they shall raise a shout of victory over you.
text_cn: 万军的上主指着自己起誓说：“我必用像蝗虫那么多的人群填塞你，对你高唱凯歌。”

text_en: It is he who made the earth by his power, who established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the heavens.
text_cn: 上主以自己的能力创造了大地，以自己的智慧奠定了寰宇，以自己的才智展布了诸天。

text_en: When he utters his voice there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he makes the mist rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings for the rain, and he brings out the wind from his storehouses.
text_cn: 他一声号令使天上的水怒号，使云彩从地极上腾，使雷声霹雳，造成豪雨，使暴风从他的仓库出发。

text_en: Everyone is stupid and without knowledge; goldsmiths are all put to shame by their idols; for their images are false, and there is no breath in them.
text_cn: 人都要自觉愚昧无知；每个银匠必因自己的刻像感到羞惭，因为所铸的像，只是“虚无”，没有气息；

text_en: They are worthless, a work of delusion; at the time of their punishment they shall perish.
text_cn: 是“虚幻”，是愚弄人的作品；惩罚时期一到，必要尽归灭亡。

text_en: Not like these is the Lord , the portion of Jacob, for he is the one who formed all things, and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance; the Lord of hosts is his name.
text_cn: 那位作雅各伯产业的，与它们却完全不同，因为他是万物的造主，以色列是作他产业的支派；他的名字叫“万军的上主。”

text_en: You are my war club, my weapon of battle: with you I smash nations; with you I destroy kingdoms;
text_cn: 巴比伦！你曾是我的锤子，作战的武器；我曾用你粉碎万民，用你毁灭邦国，

text_en: with you I smash the horse and its rider; with you I smash the chariot and the charioteer;
text_cn: 用你粉碎战马和骑士，用你粉碎战车和御夫，

text_en: with you I smash man and woman; with you I smash the old man and the boy; with you I smash the young man and the girl;
text_cn: 用你粉碎男子和妇女，用你粉碎老翁和幼童，用你粉碎少男少女，

text_en: with you I smash shepherds and their flocks; with you I smash farmers and their teams; with you I smash governors and deputies.
text_cn: 用你粉碎牧人和牲畜，用你粉碎农夫和耕牛，用你粉碎州牧和监督。

text_en: I will repay Babylon and all the inhabitants of Chaldea before your very eyes for all the wrong that they have done in Zion, says the Lord .
text_cn: 但是，如今我要在你们眼前，报复巴比伦和所有的加色丁居民，对熙雍作的一切恶事──上主的断语──

text_en: I am against you, O destroying mountain, says the Lord , that destroys the whole earth; I will stretch out my hand against you, and roll you down from the crags, and make you a burned-out mountain.
text_cn: 好事毁灭的山岭！看，我要攻击你──上主的断语──是你毁灭了整个大地，我要向你伸出我的手，使你从崖石上滚下，使你成为烈火焚毁的山岭。

text_en: No stone shall be taken from you for a corner and no stone for a foundation, but you shall be a perpetual waste, says the Lord .
text_cn: 人们不再从你那里凿取角石或基石，因为你将永远为荒丘──上主的断语。

text_en: Raise a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations; prepare the nations for war against her, summon against her the kingdoms, Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz; appoint a marshal against her, bring up horses like bristling locusts.
text_cn: 你们在地上树立旗帜，在万民间吹起号角，祝圣万民向她进攻，召集阿辣辣特和明尼及阿市革纳次王国向她进攻，派遣一员大将向他进攻；冲锋的马队，好像刺毛直竖的蚱蜢。

text_en: Prepare the nations for war against her, the kings of the Medes, with their governors and deputies, and every land under their dominion.
text_cn: 祝圣万民：玛待的君王和他的州牧，他所有的监督以及他整个版图的民众，向她进攻。

text_en: The land trembles and writhes, for the Lord ’s purposes against Babylon stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.
text_cn: 大地战栗惶悚，因为上主正在进行攻巴比伦的计划，使巴比伦地成为无人居住的荒野。

text_en: The warriors of Babylon have given up fighting, they remain in their strongholds; their strength has failed, they have become women; her buildings are set on fire, her bars are broken.
text_cn: 巴比伦的兵士放弃作战，留在堡垒中，失去了勇气，有如妇人；她的房屋已为火焚毁，她的门闩已被折断。

text_en: One runner runs to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to tell the king of Babylon that his city is taken from end to end:
text_cn: 跑差的，传信的，都相继跑去通报巴比伦王，京城四周已被占领，

text_en: the fords have been seized, the marshes have been burned with fire, and the soldiers are in panic.
text_cn: 渡口已被攻陷，要塞已遭火焚；战士都十分恐惶。

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Daughter Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden; yet a little while and the time of her harvest will come.
text_cn: 因为万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：“巴比伦女郎有如到了该践踏的禾场；还有片刻就到收割她的时期。”

text_en: “King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me; he has made me an empty vessel, he has swallowed me like a monster; he has filled his belly with my delicacies, he has spewed me out.
text_cn: 巴比伦王拿步高把我吞食毁灭，使我变成了空器皿；他仿佛一条龙，并吞了我，以我的美味满足了自己的肚腹，然后将我驱逐。

text_en: May my torn flesh be avenged on Babylon, ” the inhabitants of Zion shall say. “May my blood be avenged on the inhabitants of Chaldea, ” Jerusalem shall say.
text_cn: 熙雍的居民说：“要对巴比伦报复我身受的凌辱！”耶路撒冷说：“要对加色丁居民报复我的血债！”

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : I am going to defend your cause and take vengeance for you. I will dry up her sea and make her fountain dry;
text_cn: 为此，上主这样说：“看，我必为你辩护，报复你的冤仇，干涸她的河川，枯竭她的泉源。

text_en: and Babylon shall become a heap of ruins, a den of jackals, an object of horror and of hissing, without inhabitant.
text_cn: 巴比伦必成为一堆瓦砾，豺狼的巢穴；令人恐怖嘲笑，无人居住。

text_en: Like lions they shall roar together; they shall growl like lions’ whelps.
text_cn: 巴比伦人像壮狮一样，一起怒号，像母狮的幼雏一样，一起咆哮。

text_en: When they are inflamed, I will set out their drink and make them drunk, until they become merry and then sleep a perpetual sleep and never wake, says the Lord .
text_cn: 在他们激昂时，我必给他们摆设盛宴，使他们酣醉昏迷，长眠不醒──上主的断语──

text_en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams and goats.
text_cn: 我必使他们下到屠场，无异羔羊绵羊和山羊。

text_en: How Sheshach is taken, the pride of the whole earth seized! How Babylon has become an object of horror among the nations!
text_cn: 怎么，舍沙客竟陷落了， 全地的光荣竟遭受了劫掠？怎么，连巴比伦在万民中也变得如此凄凉？

text_en: The sea has risen over Babylon; she has been covered by its tumultuous waves.
text_cn: 海洋冲击巴比伦，使她全被惊涛怒浪所淹没；

text_en: Her cities have become an object of horror, a land of drought and a desert, a land in which no one lives, and through which no mortal passes.
text_cn: 她的城市尽化为荒野，干旱凄凉之地，再没有人居住，再没有过客。

text_en: I will punish Bel in Babylon, and make him disgorge what he has swallowed. The nations shall no longer stream to him; the wall of Babylon has fallen.
text_cn: 我必惩罚巴比伦的贝耳，由他口里夺出他所吞灭的，万民必不再向他涌来，因为巴比伦的城墙已倒塌。

text_en: Come out of her, my people! Save your lives, each of you, from the fierce anger of the Lord !
text_cn: 我的人民！你们从她那里出来，各救自己的性命脱免上主忿怒的烈火。

text_en: Do not be fainthearted or fearful at the rumors heard in the land— one year one rumor comes, the next year another, rumors of violence in the land and of ruler against ruler.
text_cn: 你们不要胆怯，不要害怕地方上流传的谣言；因为今年传来这谣言；明年又另有谣言；地方上常有暴乱，暴君互相倾轧(yà)。

text_en: Assuredly, the days are coming when I will punish the images of Babylon; her whole land shall be put to shame, and all her slain shall fall in her midst.
text_cn: 看，时日将到，我必惩罚巴比伦的偶像；使她全国饱受耻辱，国内死伤遍地。

text_en: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is in them, shall shout for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers shall come against them out of the north, says the Lord .
text_cn: 上天下地和其中所有的一切，必对巴比伦呐喊欢呼，因为从北方必有破坏者来向她进袭──上主的断语──

text_en: Babylon must fall for the slain of Israel, as the slain of all the earth have fallen because of Babylon.
text_cn: 为了以色列被刺杀的人，巴比伦也该倾覆，就如全地被刺杀的人，曾为了巴比伦而倒毙。

text_en: You survivors of the sword, go, do not linger! Remember the Lord in a distant land, and let Jerusalem come into your mind:
text_cn: 你们逃脱了刀剑的人！快走，不要停留；从远方怀念上主，思恋耶路撒冷。

text_en: We are put to shame, for we have heard insults; dishonor has covered our face, for aliens have come into the holy places of the Lord ’s house.
text_cn: 我们听到了侮辱，感到耻辱，满面羞惭，因为外方人闯进了上主殿宇的圣所。

text_en: Therefore the time is surely coming, says the Lord , when I will punish her idols, and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
text_cn: 为此，看，时日将到──上主的断语──我必惩罚她的偶像，使她国内的人都负伤呻吟；

text_en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven, and though she should fortify her strong height, from me destroyers would come upon her, says the Lord .
text_cn: 即使巴比伦爬上诸天，即使她盘据高处不可侵犯，我仍要派破坏者来向她进袭──上主的断语。

text_en: Listen! —a cry from Babylon! A great crashing from the land of the Chaldeans!
text_cn: 听，从巴比伦发出的喧嚷，从加色丁地发生的绝大破坏！

text_en: For the Lord is laying Babylon waste, and stilling her loud clamor. Their waves roar like mighty waters, the sound of their clamor resounds;
text_cn: 是上主在毁灭巴比伦，消弭其中嘈杂的声音；敌人汹涌而来，有如汪洋怒涛，扬声呐喊。

text_en: for a destroyer has come against her, against Babylon; her warriors are taken, their bows are broken; for the Lord is a God of recompense, he will repay in full.
text_cn: 果然，破坏者已来到巴比伦，她的勇士都已被擒，她的弓弩尽被折断，因为上主是报复的天主，他必严厉加以报复。

text_en: I will make her officials and her sages drunk, also her governors, her deputies, and her warriors; they shall sleep a perpetual sleep and never wake, says the King, whose name is the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 我必使她的诸侯和谋士，州牧和监督以及勇士饮醉，长眠不醒──名为万军上主君王的断语。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: The broad wall of Babylon shall be leveled to the ground, and her high gates shall be burned with fire. The peoples exhaust themselves for nothing, and the nations weary themselves only for fire.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“巴比伦广阔的城墙要被夷为平地，她高大的城门要被火焚尽：这样百姓只有白白徒劳，万民的辛苦，也只有付之一炬。”

text_en: The word that the prophet Jeremiah commanded Seraiah son of Neriah son of Mahseiah, when he went with King Zedekiah of Judah to Babylon, in the fourth year of his reign. Seraiah was the quartermaster.
text_cn: 以下是玛赫色雅的孙子，乃黎雅的儿子色辣雅同犹大王漆德克雅，在他为王第四年，同往巴比伦去时，耶肋米亚先知对他吩咐的话，那时色辣雅身为行营总督。

text_en: Jeremiah wrote in a scroll all the disasters that would come on Babylon, all these words that are written concerning Babylon.
text_cn: 耶肋米亚在一本书上记录了要降在巴比伦的一切灾祸，所记录的全是关于巴比伦的事。

text_en: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah: “When you come to Babylon, see that you read all these words,
text_cn: 耶肋米亚对色辣雅说：“你一到了巴比伦，就应设法宣读这一切话，

text_en: and say, ‘O Lord , you yourself threatened to destroy this place so that neither human beings nor animals shall live in it, and it shall be desolate forever. ’
text_cn: 然后说：上主，关于这地你亲自说过，要将它消灭，使这地无人居住，成为人和走兽绝迹的荒野。

text_en: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it, and throw it into the middle of the Euphrates,
text_cn: 你朗诵完了这本书以后，在书上系上一块石头，把书抛在幼发拉的河中，

text_en: and say, ‘Thus shall Babylon sink, to rise no more, because of the disasters that I am bringing on her. ’” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
text_cn: 然后说：巴比伦也要如此沉没，再也不能由我给她招来的灾祸中复兴。”耶肋米亚的话至此为止。
